Hijacking the comment to suggest Boxcryptor as an application to encrypt and upload files for backup. It creates encrypted volumes (think TrueCrypt or Veracrypt) divided up by the size of your Dropbox/Google Drive/etc. account, then uploads the volumes to the storage service. Volumes can then be synced and accessed across devices, and would be hackers are left having to decrypt your volume.

Boxcryptor is proprietary software. There are other encryption tools that do the same job and are also open source, although I don't know if they provide phone access the way Boxcryptor does with their app.
